subject: SIG steward nominations and evidence-collector onboarding
messages:
From: Alice Rivera <alice.rivera@compasscloud.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@compasscloud.com, security@compasscloud.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request (CompassCloud) — initial packet and timeline

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement and security teams have started the Standardized Information Gathering (SIG) exchange and attached the request packet (PDF) for Redwood. The buyer-side timeline is tight — we'd like a completed SIG + evidence index within two weeks if possible (target: 2026-07-05). Key asks:

- Completed SIG (answers filled directly into the attached PDF).
- An evidence index (mapping of documents to SIG questions).
- A point of contact for each SIG section so our security reviewers can follow up quickly.

CompassCloud has highlighted the following sections as high priority: Access Control, Audit Logging, Encryption/Key Mgmt, and Data Processing & Transfer. If you can provide the SOC 2 Type II report (latest) and an exported list of audit logs retention policy, that will accelerate review.

Please confirm receipt and share your internal steward roster + initial ETA for completion. Happy to hop on a 30m sync if that helps.

Attachments:
- CompassCloud_SIG_Request_June2026.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Best,
Alice Rivera
Senior Procurement Manager
CompassCloud
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG request (CompassCloud) — steward roster needed + evidence collector onboarding

Team — forwarding CompassCloud's SIG packet received this morning. They want the completed SIG and evidence index by 2026-07-05.

Ask: please review the requested SIG sections below and confirm who will be the steward and who will be the evidence collector (can be different people). I've created a starter index template attached.

Suggested sections (not exhaustive):
- Security policy & org
- Access control / identity management
- Audit logging & monitoring
- Encryption & key management
- Data processing & transfer controls
- Change management / patching
- Vendor management / third-party risk

Initial proposed steward picks (please confirm or propose alternate):
- Access control / identity management — ben_carter (propose)
- Audit logging & monitoring — marissa_cole (propose)
- Encryption & key management — vivek_kulkarni (propose)
- Change management / patching — stephanie_nguyen (propose)

Process I propose:
1) Owners confirm in 24 hours.
2) We run a 2-day evidence sprint (collecting exports, policy docs, configs) and populate the evidence index template.
3) I will assemble final SIG answers and the evidence index and share with CompassCloud.

Please reply with confirmations and a quick note if you need help locating artifacts (I can route to infra/security teams).

Attachment: SIG_section_index_template.csv

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Programs Manager
